content: I'm really frustrated with my bill this month. There are charges I don't recognize and it's $40 higher than usual. This is the third time this has happened and I'm considering switching providers if this isn't resolved quickly.

Thank you for contacting us. I understand your frustration regarding the billing discrepancy. I've reviewed your account and identified the error. I'll be processing a credit for the incorrect charges and ensuring this doesn't happen again.
My internet has been down for 3 hours and I work from home. This is urgent - I have a client presentation in 2 hours and need this fixed immediately!

I was able to remotely reset your modem and your service should be fully restored now. I've also applied a service credit to your account for the inconvenience. Is everything working properly on your end?
@TelecomCompany Your service has been out for 6 hours in our neighborhood. No updates, no communication. This is completely unacceptable for what we pay! #servicedown #terrible
Hi, my internet speed has been consistently slow for the past week. I'm paying for 100Mbps but only getting 15-20Mbps. Can someone help me figure out what's wrong?
My account was suspended even though I made my payment on time. This is ridiculous and I'm very upset. I need this fixed today as I rely on internet for my business.
I called yesterday about a billing issue and the agent was rude and unhelpful. They hung up on me! This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced.
Complete service outage at our business location. We have 50 employees unable to work. This is costing us thousands of dollars per hour. Need immediate response!
I can't access my account and need to pay my bill today to avoid late fees. Can someone please unlock my account immediately?
